R6I-camp-camp-0002.recDirections: From Terrace drive west along Highway 16. 200 m. West of the Kalum River turn North onto the first road (West Kalum forestry road). At 11.3 km. turn left and follow along road for approx. 800 m. where a short road leads to the right and to the trail.

R6I-grouse-atv-0002.name: By Lean-to Creek
R6I-grouse-atv-0002.pressureWhy: Busier: under 30 minutes from a city (estimate).
R6I-grouse-atv-0002.parkWhat: where the truck road ends (Lean-To FSR); unload the ATV (all terrain vehicle)

evidence.t: Road: North Lean-To Br, 4.1 km stretch.
75% of the stretch in grouse forest zones (BWBS, CWH, ESSF, ICH, IDF, MS, SBPS, SBS).
2 cutblocks touch the road (30 years old or less): edges and clover.
10 wetlands, lakes or creeks along the road: riparian edges.
Black bear: young cutblocks and burns grow berries in late summer and fall (Tip).

seasonRows.notes: No row in the Region 6 table (pages 50 and 51), so no general open season (page 5: open seasons are only those in the synopsis).

plan: Drive: from City of Terrace, about 27 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate). Via Beam Station Rd, Queensway Dr, Hwy 16, Eby St.
Park: 54.64561, -128.62361, where the truck road ends (Lean-To FSR); unload the ATV (all terrain vehicle). Map links below.
Walk 1.3 km to the start. Ride: the North Lean-To Br stretch, 4.1 km one way. About 82 min one way at 3 km/h.
Hunt: grouse, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Walk slowly in the first and last 2 hours of light. Watch where cutblocks and creeks meet the road (Tip).
Use: .22 rimfire for a sitting grouse inside 25 m (27 yd), or a shotgun with lead 6 or 7.5 (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 6-15, Region 6. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
